idea-plugin.name: Pre-Consent Tracker Audit for EU Client Websites
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the analytics, pixels, fonts and embeds that fire before your cookie banner is answered - in the source, before you deploy. 24 rules.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Pre-Consent Tracker Audit for EU Client Websites: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 24 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/consent-audit-eu (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/consent-audit-eu
